basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old guy from Watford, UK, with a passion for football (both watching and playing) and a keen interest in collecting vinyl records. I work as an IT support specialist, which allows me to mix my love for technology with helping others. During weekdays, I usually browse Reddit during my lunch break and in the evenings after 7 PM. On weekends, I'm more active, especially when there's a big match or I find a new vinyl to discuss. I'm currently single, but I enjoy the freedom to dive deep into my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, but I'm mostly self-taught when it comes to football and vinyl collecting. My love for football started in childhood, playing in local clubs and cheering for Watford FC. Vinyl collecting was a hobby I picked up during university, starting with classic rock and expanding into jazz and electronic.
